# Science Publishing Group

> An international academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed journals, special issues, and conference proceedings across multidisciplinary science and research fields.

Science Publishing Group (SciencePG) operates a comprehensive platform for academic publishing, featuring journals across life sciences, medical sciences, physical sciences, engineering, social sciences, and humanities. The platform facilitates scholarly communication through open-access publishing, special issue organization, and conference proceedings publication.

## Key Topics

- academic publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- open-access publishing

- [Medical and Health Sciences Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/15): Medical and health sciences journals directory.

- [Earth, Energy and Environmental Sciences Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/16): Earth, energy and environmental sciences journals directory.

- [Materials Science Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/51): Materials science journals directory.
- [Computer Science and AI Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/23): Computer science and AI journals directory.
- [Architecture and Engineering Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/60): Architecture and engineering journals directory.
- [Applied Sciences and Engineering Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/18): Applied sciences and engineering journals directory.

- [Education and Sports Science Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/19): Education and sports science journals directory.
- [Humanities and Social Sciences Journals](https://sciencepg.com/journals/browse-by-subject/20): Humanities and social sciences journals directory.

## Special Issues and Conferences

- [Ongoing Special Issues](https://sciencepg.com/special-issues/ongoing): Directory of ongoing special issues with open calls for papers.
- [Published Special Issues Archive](https://sciencepg.com/special-issues/published): Archive of published special issues across disciplines.
- [Conference Proceedings](https://sciencepg.com/proceedings): Conference proceedings directory organized by discipline.
- [Conference Special Issues](https://sciencepg.com/conference-special-issue): Conference special issue submission and publication information.

## Submission and Publishing Guidelines

- [Special Issue Guidelines](https://sciencepg.com/special-issues/guidelines): Guidelines for special issue organization and submission requirements.
- [Propose a Special Issue](https://sciencepg.com/special-issues/propose): Instructions for proposing special issues and conference proceedings.
